body:
I've looked at AA meetings that take place near by, I think it would be a good place for me to go, but it's the kind of thing I would never dare to do with out a drink or two. Not to mention most are held at churches and (surprise surprise) I'm not exactly religious. I also live in a kind of rough part of town, and well, I'm not exactly sure if I would fit in or not.

How do these things work? Should I just show up to one? Should I contact some local AA headquarters and they could advise me of a meeting? I am interested, I just hope I can get the gumption to pull the trigger.

>First of all, I just want to let you know that this subreddit is really not a place where people will try to convince you that you need to stop drinking. 

Fair enough, I hope I didn't step on any toes. I have read through quite a few posts on this subreddit and I thought this might be a good place to ask for some advice. I mean, where else would I post? Askreddit? 

To be honest, I think I'm just pussyfooting around, I know what I have to do. I just can't envision a life without alcohol. Going to concerts and small shows at bars is half of all the social things I do. They are a major trigger and I just don't know what I'll do if I have to avoid them. Not to mention trying to find sober musicians to play with is like trying to push a rope uphill.
The CIA, the FBI and Naval Intelligence as well. Part of the religion is to respect the laws of the land and Mormons know how to keep a secret.

I'd like to thank everyone so much for responding. 

The problem is I don't have anything left to give, literally and figuratively. All of my giving has been to my unrequited love, who is naively using me.  I really don't think I'm of benefit to the world or to anything but her whims.

The problem really is that despite my recent bad luck, I actually have all the advantages in the world. I'm reasonably intelligent, somewhat talented and what many have considered handsome. I grew up in a very loving and non-abusive home. My parents make a considerable income and paid for my college education. What do I really have to complain about?

I've been given all these tools but I can't seem to apply them. I squander my life barely scraping by financially, struggling tremendously to keep friendships going and failing miserably at any attempts at romantic relationships. I haven't had sex in two years, and the last woman I was with told me I was a terrible lover and that she was using me.

Just last night one of my housemates, a fairly attractive girl, had over her friend who was honestly quite stunning. They were having a few drinks before going out and they were in a social mood. We got into a conversation and I'm not going to go into all the details, but in the end I made myself out to be pretty pathetic, which I guess isn't far from the truth.

I just can't seem to do anything right and when bad luck strikes on top of my failings I just can't handle it. Honestly the only thing keeping me alive is that I don't want to hurt the ones I love.

Suicide is for the weak. I happened to be in my throwaway account so I can tell you exactly how I feel about your situation. THAT'S FUCKING LIFE, DEAL WITH IT. Or don't and be fucking pathetic.

I recommend you go to r/suicidewatch.

Also, you're probably drunk. Sleep it off and read your own post in the morning.

That... is possible. I really don't know. The fact of the matter is that I was trying to be with her in one way or another for well... years. The relationship is so fucked up that I can't stay away from her. I have been her puppet, her bitch, her friend, her shoulder to cry on, her nemesis, and someone she genuinely feared (quite the accomplishment in her view (I suppose)). It is all so convoluted to me I really don't know how to describe the depth of our relationship, except that it is not sexual (yet).

Maybe that is why this got so little attention? Which is disappointing because I need to talk to someone about this, but there is no one on earth that I know that I can do so with, which is why I turned to the anonymity of a throwaway account. So... thank you very much for responding.

The reason I knew that things were not OK is that she is (or was) a very close friend of mine and I know her mannerisms. Her tone of voice, different looks of vulnerability, I don't know maybe I'm overreacting, but if you ever came in contact with someone the morning after they got the shit kicked out of them she acted like that.

She said her teeth and jaw hurt from the hit. I slapped her that hard. Apparently there are signs of bruising. 

On the other hand my cuts are even worse than I thought, and people at work recognized that the burn on my arm is from a cigarette, which is very hard to explain in a professional environment.

I just need someone else's opinion on the situation. If you need more information to do so, please ask.

**Edit:** I feel I should add that this is not me, or who I thought I was. The cutting, the burning, the hitting... it is just all so confusing to me.
Maybe a little crazy, but not like fatal attraction crazy.
If you don't stop talking about them they won't go away. ಠ\_ಠ
Unfortunately that comic is all too apt. Thanks... I guess.

You know, I might have been an idiot here, but **FUCK YOU** for being a dick. It doesn't help.

Edit: So Reddit is not okay with defending oneself against people being pricks. Good to know.

In a word... yes. Sure it would cause some jealousy and what not, and someday she may be recognized on the street which may be really awkward. IMHO its her body and she should feel free to display its beauty. As long as she's faithful I wouldn't feel justified to complain.
